reason: Having refused third-party cloud tools for years out of fear of client data leaks, I am not ready to purchase an annual subscription until I have proof that connecting Google Drive won't expose our firm's existing confidential files. Reviewing ROC filing annexures late at night is stressful enough without worrying about third-party software accessing our private ITR and PAN documents.
objection: Will connecting my Google Drive give Docketra access to read all my firm's private files?
would_change_my_mind: A verifiable technical guarantee and permission audit proving that the Google OAuth connection is strictly confined to the /Docketra/ folder with zero ability to read or scan any preexisting client files in our Drive.
